caps.cap: ...and left-click NetworkTables 4. The one marked Default is the same.
Left-click the search box, and type stick.
Left-click and drag leftY down into Left Axis.
Start with the gamepad joysticks at their resting positions. leftY is close to 0.
Push the left stick part way forward, and it goes negative.
The graph's scale changes as it zooms to fit. Read the number next to leftY, or compare the lines to the graph's scale.
All the way forward, and it's close to -1.
Forward is -1 on gamepads. That's how they're made, not a mistake in your code.
Take your thumb off the stick: it springs back to 0.
Pull it part way toward you: a little positive.
All the way toward you: close to +1.
Take your thumb off the stick.
Switch back to Android Studio: ⌘Tab on a Mac, Alt+Tab on Windows and Ubuntu.
